dissent: P1-ASK-CREDIT-E3: Case 2 asks for a justified comparison control. Full credit additionally mandates residual-group/conversion measurements and gas-loss limits. A learner can supply every explicit request with a matched dry/moist comparison, explain urethane versus amine/urea, compute 2 mmol CO2, 4 mmol NCO consumed and 96 mmol remaining, and reject bubbles as proof of dry PU success, yet lose full credit because the two additional required elements were not disclosed. The complete-path correction does not remove this assessment mismatch.

P1-LIMIT-AMBIGUITY: Case 1 requests one limit, while the full-credit wording can be read as requiring all three conversion/adhesion/temperature reservations. It should state that one scientifically justified limit suffices or name all required reservations in the task.

SOURCE-PU-COMPONENT: Current direct f947 partner routes include source clauses restricted to radical polymerisation, polykondensation or other sibling content. In particular the actual national atlas offers f947 in SN/TH SekI, MV GK/LK and SL GK/LK, although the bound literal clauses and inspected original PDFs do not specify PU/polyaddition. NI applicability is inherited through the Naturstoffe cluster from functional-group identification. An exact source row or a correct partner union does not make every partner supported. Keep explicit HE/BW/BY/TH polyaddition clauses and relevant sibling clauses; resolve f947 component routing before complete national-source acceptance.

V1-360CSS-LEGIBILITY: At actual 360 CSS px the image is 360 by 200.921875 px; four horizontal panels leave the right twelve-line process paragraph and repeat-unit lettering very small. Text remains a required carrier of functionality, stoichiometry and reaction-control meaning; this phone presentation does not support a clean legibility acceptance. expectations.essentialUnderstandingEn: Isocyanate and alcohol form urethane groups without a small-molecule byproduct in the dry main reaction.

applicationCaseBriefs.taskDemandDe: Formuliere die trockene Reaktion R–N=C=O + HO–R′ einschließlich der Produktstruktur. Leite außerdem aus dem angegebenen Diol und Diisocyanat eine valenzrichtige Wiederholungseinheit der linearen Polyurethankette in Charge L ab. Zähle Gruppen und erkläre Ketten- bzw Vernetzungstendenz. Übertrage auf einen formstabilen Klebstoff und nenne eine Grenze des idealen Modells.
applicationCaseBriefs.taskDemandEn: Formulate the dry reaction R–N=C=O + HO–R′ including the product structure. Additionally derive a valence-correct repeat unit of the linear polyurethane chain in batch L from the supplied diol and diisocyanate. Count groups and explain chain versus crosslinking tendencies. Apply to a shape-stable adhesive and state one limit of the ideal model.
applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceDe: Produkt R–NH–C(=O)–O–R′, kein H₂O. L je 200 mol OH/NCO, beide bifunktionell: lineare Ketten möglich. N 210 mol OH und 210 mol NCO; Triol ermöglicht Verzweigungen und bei ausreichender Umsetzung ein Netz. Wiederholung –O–R′–O–C(=O)–NH–R–NH–C(=O)–. N ist plausible formstabile Wahl; Vernetzungsgrad, Haftung, Temperatur und vollständiger Umsatz sind nicht allein durch Äquivalenz bewiesen.
applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceEn: Product R–NH–C(=O)–O–R′, no H₂O. L has 200 mol each OH/NCO and both monomers are bifunctional: linear chains are possible. N has 210 mol each OH/NCO; triol permits branches and a network at sufficient conversion. Repeat –O–R′–O–C(=O)–NH–R–NH–C(=O)–. N is a plausible shape-stable choice; equivalence alone proves neither crosslink density, adhesion, service temperature nor complete conversion.
applicationCaseBriefs.understandingFocusDe: Fallbezogene Aspekte: R–NH–C(=O)–O–R′ und valenzrichtiges Urethan-Repetiermotiv, ohne Wasserabspaltung. / L: 200/200 mol OH/NCO; N: 210/210 mol, Triol zählt drei OH-Gruppen. / L linear möglich, N verzweigungs-/netzfähig; N-Klebstoff nur unter Umsatz/Haftungs-/Temperaturvorbehalt. Die Verknüpfung zu Erwartungs-IDs behauptet keine vollständige Erfüllung jeder Gesamtprofilerwartung in diesem Einzelfall.
applicationCaseBriefs.understandingFocusEn: Case-specific aspects: R–NH–C(=O)–O–R′ and valence-correct urethane repeat motif, without water elimination. / L: 200/200 mol OH/NCO; N: 210/210 mol, triol contributes three OH groups. / L may be linear, N permits branching/network; N adhesive choice remains conditional on conversion/adhesion/temperature. Links to expectation IDs do not assert complete fulfilment of every whole-profile expectation in this one case.

applicationCaseBriefs.taskDemandDe: Erkläre Hauptreaktion und Nebenreaktion. Berechne die theoretische CO₂-Stoffmenge, den NCO-Verbrauch und den dann für OH verbleibenden NCO-Vorrat, wenn die angegebenen 2 mmol Wasser den vollständigen gegebenen Zweischrittpfad durchlaufen. Beurteile Gleichsetzung von Blasen mit erfolgreicher trockener Polyaddition und begründe eine Vergleichskontrolle.
applicationCaseBriefs.taskDemandEn: Explain main and side reactions. Calculate the theoretical amount of CO₂, NCO consumption and the NCO inventory then remaining for OH if the supplied 2 mmol water undergo the complete given two-step route. Assess whether bubbles prove successful dry polyaddition and justify a comparison control.
applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceDe: Trocken entsteht Urethan ohne Gasabspaltung.2 mmol Wasser können 2 mmol CO₂ und nach anschließender Harnstoffbildung 4 mmol NCO-Verbrauch bewirken; für OH bleiben maximal 96 mmol NCO dieses Pfads. Blasen stützen Wassernebenreaktion, nicht Qualität des PU-Netzes. Trocken/feucht bei identischen übrigen Bedingungen sowie Restgruppen-/Umsatzmessung trennen die Effekte; tatsächliche Gasmenge kann durch Löslichkeit/Verlust abweichen.
applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceEn: Dry reaction forms urethane without gas elimination.2 mmol water may produce 2 mmol CO₂ and consume 4 mmol NCO after subsequent urea formation, leaving at most 96 mmol NCO for OH in this route. Bubbles support the water side reaction, not PU-network quality. Matched dry/moist controls and residual-group/conversion measurements separate effects; actual gas collection may differ through dissolution or loss.
